data.name: Balavant
data.gender_notes: Balavant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balavant is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'bal' (strength, power) and 'vant' (possessor). This name is bestowed upon a boy to signify his inherent bravery and strength. It is a name of respect and reverence in Hindu culture. The name Balavant carries the meaning “Brave, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balavant usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Balavant belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balavant total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Balavant is a common name among warriors, rulers, and heroes in Hindu mythology and literature, such as Bala Rama, Balarama, and Bali Chal Ravana.
